scope: Functional failures and intentional gate-omission verification; filtered-out cases are not final skipped cases or additional passes.

runs.method: Original mounted Workbench lacks the deliberate unchanged-text action; ordinary saves still pass.
failedCases: deliberately re-filing unchanged saved text offers a deliberate filing action without making an arbitrary edit or ordinary save

runs.method: Review regressions for a bare-module ancestor receipt and a retired-visit success claim, before correction.
failedCases: saved-section receipt agrees with canonical filing identity rejects bare module ancestor
unchanged filing retains one attempt and its exact reviewed owner does not show an old success when A is revisited before its reply

runs.method: Review regression for a contradictory positive result nested in an array, before bounded traversal correction.
failedCases: uncertain or contradictory filing replies never permit blind replay holds 'nested result array' across close/reopen and A → B → A

runs.method: Original mounted section PATCH returns ordinary metadata success without repairing the filing.
failedCases: a freeze refuses a document whose filed copy is not its text re-files unchanged saved text without an Authoring content revision

runs.method: Gate verification against retained pre-hardening helper with only full-view/QMS checks omitted; current helper immediately restored.
failedCases: deliberate unchanged filing retains current locked governance requires full-document view even when the selected section remains editable
deliberate unchanged filing retains current locked governance rechecks current QMS control inside the filing transaction

runs.method: Gate verification against retained pre-hardening helper using stale session email; canonical current-read helper immediately restored.
failedCases: deliberate unchanged filing rechecks current write access uses the current account email when a stale JWT still matches an old email-only document grant
